newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ranger Oil rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ranger Oil rated buy.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Frank Bracken confirmed he started coverage of Ranger Oil Ltd with a buy rating.

-- "The market has really glommed onto the concept of production growth through international venues," he said, but noted Ranger Oil's stock has been an "enormous laggard" to its peers even though its production growth appears just as good.
-- "It's got a superior balance sheet and low debt to total cap," he added.
-- The analyst set a 12-month price target of $11 and per-share earnings estimates of $0.09 for 1996, $0.28 for 1997 and $0.50 for 1998.
-- The stock ended at eight Friday in U.S. trading.
